Bigg Boss 10 Telugu: Varshini Is the Main Glamour Attraction

Bigg Boss 10 Telugu is all set to premiere in a week, and the names of several probable contestants have already started doing the rounds…

venkat

Sep 01, 202606:20 am IST Bigg Boss Telugu 10Varshini Sounderajan
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:11
Instaread

Bigg Boss 10 Telugu is all set to premiere in a week, and the names of several probable contestants have already started doing the rounds on social media.

This season is expected to feature a mix of film personalities, television actors and social media influencers.

While there are a few familiar names among the male contestants, Varshini Sounderajan is emerging as the most popular female celebrity in the rumoured lineup.

Every season of Bigg Boss Telugu tends to have a contestant who grabs attention with their glamour and personality, and Varshini is expected to fill that space this time.

Known for her glamorous social media presence, Varshini has also acted alongside several popular stars in films.

However, television and social media have played a bigger role in making her a familiar face among audiences.

She currently has around two million followers on Instagram and enjoys a strong following among younger viewers.

Varshini is also known for her outspoken and bold personality.

With Nagarjuna Akkineni returning as the host, it remains to be seen how she performs inside the Bigg Boss 10 Telugu house and whether she emerges as one of the major attractions of the season.
